name: Tequesta
dining_districts: the riverfront and club kitchens along the Loxahatchee
intro: Tequesta is the county's northern edge — a small village on the Loxahatchee River where the dining scene concentrates around Tequesta Drive's bistros and cafes, a handful of beloved neighborhood institutions on US-1, and club kitchens serving riverfront and golf communities. It is the kind of town where a restaurant's reputation is thirty years deep and the produce had better respect that.

We run Tequesta at the very top of the north county route, about seventy-five minutes from the Pompano Beach warehouse, on the same terms as every other stop: no delivery fees for the distance, split cases for small village kitchens, and standing orders that hold spec for the clubs. Village kitchens order tonight, receive tomorrow morning — every day of the week.
route_note: About 75 minutes from our Pompano Beach warehouse — the final stop north on the county route, arriving before lunch prep.

faqs_unique.q: Does Tequesta's distance mean delivery fees or minimums?
faqs_unique.a: No. Tequesta rides the standard north county route — no delivery fees, no fuel charges, no minimums, same terms as kitchens ten minutes from our dock.

faqs_unique.q: Do you supply club and riverfront kitchens in Tequesta?
faqs_unique.a: Yes. Club dining rooms and riverfront kitchens run standing orders with consistent specs, plus split cases for member events.

cta_text: Tell us your village kitchen's staples or your club's spec — we will bring full-service produce delivery to the top of the county, daily.
